exact.兩側空間解析度完全相等 (0 偏差): both sides have exactly equal spatial resolution (0 offset)
exact.💡 原始 U-Net 由於未填充，572×572 輸入經過 4 層下取樣與上取樣: 💡 Because the original U-Net uses no padding, a 572×572 input yields a final 388×388 segmentation map after 4 levels of downsampling and upsampling.
exact.💡 現代改進版全程使用 Same Padding，512×512 輸入最終輸出恰: 💡 The modern improved version uses same padding throughout, so a 512×512 input gives exactly a 512×512 output, with no border cropping needed.
exact.上取樣以 2×2 deconvolution（轉置卷積 / up-convolu: Upsampling is done with a 2×2 deconvolution (transposed convolution / up-convolution); Fig. 17 illustrates this operation concretely.
exact.不補邊（unpadded）的 3×3 卷積每做一次就會吃掉 2 個畫素邊界，導致: Each unpadded 3×3 convolution eats a 2-pixel border, so the encoder feature maps on the left are larger than the decoder ones on the right, and they must be cropped to align before the skip connection; nowadays padding can also be used to avoid this.
exact.原文明確指出：contracting path 捕捉 contextual in: The original text states explicitly: the contracting path captures contextual information, and the expansive path is responsible for precise localization.
exact.針對生醫分割任務（Biomedical Segmentation）；輸出特徵圖具: Aimed at biomedical segmentation; the output feature map has the same spatial size as the input, with c class channels, followed by a per-pixel softmax and cross-entropy loss.

59e2c2d9ea37.en: 5.5 U-Net: Contracting–Expansive Paths and Medical Segmentation

39a9a8bc10e2.zh: 分割任務既要掌握巨觀組織語境（Context），又要鎖定微觀邊界定位（Localization）！U-Net 創立收縮–擴張對稱雙翼，透過跳躍連線（Skip Connection）將低階空間幾何細節直傳解碼器，奠定生醫分割不可動搖的黃金典範。
39a9a8bc10e2.en: Segmentation must grasp the macroscopic tissue context and also pin down microscopic boundary localization! U-Net introduced the symmetric contracting–expansive pair of wings and, through skip connections, passes low-level spatial geometric detail straight to the decoder, establishing the unshakable gold standard of biomedical segmentation.

c0f334b2fd66.zh: 既然深層特徵丟失空間邊界，如何讓分割邊界精確到單一畫素？
c0f334b2fd66.en: Since deep features lose spatial boundaries, how can segmentation boundaries be accurate to a single pixel?

38c2e9587c80.zh:
左翼收縮抓全域語境，右翼擴張逐步還原解析度！
中央橫越的跳躍連線（Skip Connection）將淺層高解析空間細節直接 Concat 接回擴張層，徹底解決下取樣造成的定位資訊流失！
38c2e9587c80.en:
The left wing contracts to capture global context; the right wing expands to restore resolution step by step!
The skip connections crossing the middle concat the shallow high-resolution spatial details directly back into the expansive layers, completely solving the loss of localization information caused by downsampling!

c384e2e07a81.en: U-Net's two-wing design philosophy: diagnosing context and reconstructing boundaries

1911eea8f9fa.zh: 2015 年由 Olaf Ronneberger 等人提出的 U-Net，最初奪得 ISBI 電子顯微鏡神經結構分割挑戰賽冠軍。在語意分割（Semantic Segmentation）任務中，模型必須回答兩個互斥又相互依存的難題：
1911eea8f9fa.en: U-Net, proposed by Olaf Ronneberger et al. in 2015, first won the ISBI challenge for segmenting neuronal structures in electron microscopy. In semantic segmentation tasks, a model must answer two problems that are mutually exclusive yet interdependent:

cd2f06498dd0.zh: 📉 收縮路徑 Contracting Path（左翼 · 編碼器）

67fa11df098c.zh: 核心職能： 捕捉「語境與上下文（Context）」——識別這團區域到底是什麼組織或細胞。
67fa11df098c.en: Core role: capture the "context"—recognize what tissue or cell this region actually is.

21a63705a166.zh: 標準步階： 每次由兩次 $3\times 3$ 卷積（均接 ReLU）組成，隨後以 stride 2 的 $2\times 2$ max pooling 進行下取樣。
21a63705a166.en: Standard step: each step consists of two $3\times 3$ convolutions (each followed by ReLU), then downsampling by $2\times 2$ max pooling with stride 2.

c886324f07a6.zh: 維度轉換： 空間解析度減半（$\frac{H}{2} \times \frac{W}{2}$），特徵通道數翻倍（$64 \to 128 \to 256 \to 512$），保障語意表達容量。
c886324f07a6.en: Dimension change: the spatial resolution is halved ($\frac{H}{2} \times \frac{W}{2}$) and the number of feature channels doubles ($64 \to 128 \to 256 \to 512$), ensuring capacity for semantic representation.

033f021ada69.zh: 📈 擴張路徑 Expansive Path（右翼 · 解碼器）

6cf75d51c79c.zh: 核心職能： 實現「精準定位（Precise Localization）」——把組織與背景的邊界切齊在精確的畫素座標。
6cf75d51c79c.en: Core role: achieve "precise localization"—align the boundary between tissue and background at exact pixel coordinates.

7ce6d6f95fea.zh: 標準步階： 不用 Pooling，改用 $2\times 2$ 轉置卷積（Transposed Conv / Deconv）上取樣，通道數減半。
7ce6d6f95fea.en: Standard step: no pooling; instead, upsampling with a $2\times 2$ transposed convolution (deconvolution), which halves the number of channels.

7d4c6414aa95.zh: 跳躍融合： 與左翼對應層特徵圖進行通道串接（Filter Concatenation），隨後再接兩次 $3\times 3$ 卷積 + ReLU。
7d4c6414aa95.en: Skip fusion: concatenate along the channels (filter concatenation) with the feature map of the corresponding left-wing layer, followed by two more $3\times 3$ convolutions + ReLU.

723ec8e5358e.zh: 02 / 幾何骨架視覺化 · U-Net Architecture

2f1b0419994a.en: Anatomy of the classic U-Net architecture: skip-connection concat and mirrored sizes (Fig. 16)

fed9babf5c3f.zh: U-Net：左邊收縮抓語境，右邊擴張還原位置；跳接把細節 concat 回來
fed9babf5c3f.en: U-Net: the left contracts for context, the right expands to restore position; skips concat the details back

8dc9a2d1c33a.zh: 跳躍連線：左邊的空間幾何細節直接接到右邊
8dc9a2d1c33a.en: Skip connection: spatial geometric detail from the left goes straight to the right

cfc1828d0543.zh: 原始 unpadded 3×3 會縮邊 → 跳接前必須 crop 對齊
cfc1828d0543.en: Original unpadded 3×3 shrinks the borders → must crop to align before skipping

94e411736448.zh: 放大靠 2×2 轉置卷積，不是池化
94e411736448.en: Enlarging uses 2×2 transposed convolution, not pooling

1877f3f34a75.zh: 語意分割需要兩者：知道「大概是什麼組織」＋對齊「邊界在哪一畫素」
1877f3f34a75.en: Semantic segmentation needs both: know "roughly what tissue" + align "which pixel the boundary is at"

aa0fc38a7bf9.zh: 每步：兩次 3×3+ReLU；下取樣通道翻倍、上取樣通道減半；輸出與輸入具相同空間維度、c 類 Softmax
aa0fc38a7bf9.en: Each step: two 3×3+ReLU; channels double when downsampling, halve when upsampling; output has the input's spatial size, c-class softmax

290b9b6322ef.zh: 反直覺先驗：深層網路把特徵圖縮太小會丟失邊界幾何——U 形不是美學裝飾，是把細節從左邊借回來！
290b9b6322ef.en: Counterintuitive prior: shrinking feature maps too far in deep nets loses boundary geometry—the U shape isn't decoration, it borrows details back from the left!

2d8a3e949a59.zh: 生醫分割出身 · 損失 Cross-Entropy · 原作 Batch Size = 1 · 帶動量 Momentum = 0.9
2d8a3e949a59.en: Born in biomedical segmentation · loss: cross-entropy · original batch size = 1 · momentum = 0.9

d3656f0bfa67.zh: 跳躍連線的本質：空間邊界資訊傳遞
d3656f0bfa67.en: The essence of skip connections: passing spatial boundary information

1ac9ec8abf8c.zh: 傳統全卷積網路在連續下取樣後，空間邊界資訊已經退化成粗糙的區塊。U-Net 的革命性創舉在於橫跨編碼與解碼兩端的跳躍連線（Skip Connection）：
1ac9ec8abf8c.en: In a traditional fully convolutional network, after repeated downsampling the spatial boundary information has degraded into coarse blocks. U-Net's revolutionary move is the skip connections spanning the encoder and decoder:

54da47601960.zh: 特徵拼接 Concat： 不是殘差網路的相加（Add），而是將左翼的淺層特徵圖與右翼的上取樣特徵圖在通道維度（Channel Axis）並聯拼接。
54da47601960.en: Feature concatenation (concat): not the addition (add) of residual networks, but concatenating the left wing's shallow feature map and the right wing's upsampled feature map side by side along the channel axis.

e101fd241aa9.zh: 尺寸對齊與裁切（Crop）： 原論文採用無填充卷積（Unpadded Conv），每次 $3\times 3$ 卷積會使長寬各縮小 2 畫素。導致左側淺層空間尺寸大於右側，因此跳接時必須進行中央裁切（Crop）！
e101fd241aa9.en: Size alignment and cropping: the original paper uses unpadded convolutions, and each $3\times 3$ convolution shrinks the height and width by 2 pixels each. As a result, the spatial size on the shallow left side is larger than on the right, so a center crop is required at the skip connection!

c772713b2d88.zh: 現代實作演進： 現代 PyTorch 實作普遍採用 `padding=1` 的 Same Padding，直接讓長寬在卷積前後保持一致，省去了手動裁切的繁瑣。
c772713b2d88.en: How modern implementations evolved: modern PyTorch implementations generally use same padding with `padding=1`, which keeps the height and width the same before and after each convolution and saves the hassle of manual cropping.

02d7fefced2b.en: A learnable expanding operation with stride 2: spatial resolution doubles, channel count halves

5c518d94d337.en: Every stage is two consecutive $3\times 3$ conv + ReLU

088849fefb78.en: Deepens the nonlinear expressive power while keeping an effective local receptive field

8cf558ed4b27.en: Outputs $c$-dimensional logits per pixel, followed by softmax for classification

935aa0d3189e.en: Evaluates the probability that each pixel is correctly classified as foreground tissue or background

cfa89f3796e5.zh: B. 因為 softmax 會改變空間大小

7637e1b4d33e.zh: 對稱雙翼各司其職： 左收縮路徑抓語境組織上下文，右擴張路徑還原高解析度空間定位。
7637e1b4d33e.en: Symmetric wings, each with its own job: the left contracting path captures the tissue context; the right expansive path restores high-resolution spatial localization.

143e663ddbde.zh: 跳躍連線 Concat 細節： 淺層未被下取樣沖刷的高頻幾何邊緣，直接橫渡接回解碼器，解決深層定位模糊的宿命難題。
143e663ddbde.en: Skip-connection concat details: the high-frequency geometric edges of the shallow layers, not yet washed out by downsampling, cross straight back to the decoder, solving the inevitable problem of blurry localization in deep layers.

e5493478c760.zh: 轉置卷積上取樣（Fig. 17）： $2\times 2$ 反摺積將空間維度翻倍、通道數減半，搭配兩次 $3\times 3$ 卷積逐步重構目標邊界。
e5493478c760.en: Transposed-convolution upsampling (Fig. 17): a $2\times 2$ deconvolution doubles the spatial dimensions and halves the channel count, and together with two $3\times 3$ convolutions it reconstructs the target boundaries step by step.

2972f3dafcb9.zh: 醫學影像分割的基石： 逐畫素 Softmax 分類與交叉熵損失，配合單張切片（Batch Size = 1）高動量最佳化，至今仍是生醫 AI 的不可替代標準！
2972f3dafcb9.en: The cornerstone of medical image segmentation: per-pixel softmax classification and cross-entropy loss, with high-momentum optimization on single slices (Batch Size = 1), remain the irreplaceable standard of biomedical AI to this day!
